sections.advice: Treat Food stop in Balbigny → Photo stop near Pélussin as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Photo stop near Pélussin → Near Irigny is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Bourgoin-Jallieu → Scenic stretch near Tignieu as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
